title: "Stress Testing"
subtitle: "Deterministic historical counterfactuals"
---



## Concept

The stress module asks a deliberately limited question:

> How would the composite index change if one or several standardized
> dimensions moved to historically adverse configurations?

These are deterministic counterfactuals.

They are not probability models.

- credit Q95;
- solvency Q95;
- joint five-dimension Q95;
- worst historical joint configuration.

## Interpretation of values outside 0–100

The historical 0–100 transformation uses the observed historical range
as its reference.

A counterfactual scenario may therefore produce a reference-scale value
above 100 if it exceeds the historical maximum.

The implementation deliberately does not truncate such values.
